name: arch
description: Review generated and existing code for reuse, dependency health, architectural fit, and accidental complexity.

interface.shortDescription: Keep generated code simple and maintainable.
interface.longDescription: Evidence-first architectural oversight for finding duplicated behavior, stale or deprecated dependencies, boundary violations, brittle workarounds, and unjustified complexity without forcing pattern-heavy rewrites.
defaultPrompt: Review this change for architectural and maintainability risks.
Prefer repository reuse and the smallest language-idiomatic design.
